title: Dreadmist Den
wikitext:
[[File:Dreadmist Den.jpg|thumb|Dreadmist Den.]]

'''Dreadmist Den''' is a [[Burning Blade]] cultist holding located within [[Dreadmist Peak]]. It contains the [[Demon Seed]], an invaluable artifact to the Cult. The den is perpetually shrouded in a dark red mist that taints the peak and cloaks the nefarious demon worshippers who live there in eternal twilight.
